3: /**
4:  * Settings change broadcast.
5:  *
6:  * The worker (agent-server-stdio) keeps its own SettingsManager
7:  * instance; without an explicit reload it ignores edits the user
8:  * makes through the settings page. The "codeshell:settings-changed"
9:  * event is App.tsx's signal to dispatch configure({reloadModels:
10:  * true}) at the worker. Every successful settings write must fire
11:  * the event — historically callers forgot, which is exactly the
12:  * "project-level settings 不生效" bug from TODO-week.md #3.
13:  *
14:  * This helper centralises the dispatch so call sites just go through
15:  * `writeSettings(...)` and don't have to remember.
16:  */
17: 
18: export function notifySettingsChanged(): void {
19:   window.dispatchEvent(new Event("codeshell:settings-changed"));
20: }
21: 
22: export async function writeSettings(
23:   scope: "user" | "project",
24:   patch: Record<string, unknown>,
25:   projectPath?: string,
26: ): Promise<void> {
27:   await updateScopedSettings(scope, patch, projectPath);
28:   notifySettingsChanged();
29: }
